hook: This is broad political satire, not horror. It recasts real US politicians and Supreme Court justices as wizards, demons and Foundation pawns, and it is packed with crude jokes about bodily functions, so treat it as a comedy that is loud on purpose. The article leans on news events from 2015 to 2019 that it names directly, but the absurdity mostly carries itself.
whyItMatters: The author's note at the top places it in a line running back to SCP-4444, calling it the oversized offspring of that article's successor, so it is meant to be read as part of a family of alternate-history farces. It is also a big ensemble piece, with Light, Cairns, Pathos Crow, Glass, Gears and other named staff all getting a scene. Because it mocks living public figures by name, how well it lands will depend a great deal on the individual reader.
thingsToNotice:
The premise is that Charles Evans Hughes summoned a foul-mouthed imp called Old Gorman in 1916, buried it under the Capitol steps out of spite, and a century of Washington's chaos fattened it into an archdemon; the only fix is a powerful reality sink in the Oval Office, and the only adult candidate who qualifies (Clef is vetoed instantly) is Donald Trump. The running gag of Project Whirlwind is that its 160 agents keep arriving to find someone else already doing their dirty work, from Flynn naked with the Russian ambassador to Roger Stone and the hacking, and Light finally admits the result would have happened without them.

The second half flips into damage control once Mueller is appointed, including the staff visiting the Trump family disguised as Russians (Cairns in an old woman's body, Crow as their dog) and Merlo dodging FBI questions by claiming to be a performance artist who urinates on people. The climax reveals Tiffany Trump as a would-be demonic sorceress who fuses Ivanka, Donald Jr. and Eric with Gorman into a three-headed monster, and Ruth Bader Ginsburg, built up all along as a self-proclaimed Grand Arcanist, finally gets her fight and seals the demon by ordering it to eat her ass. The resolution is just as flippant: the siblings are saved, Tiffany is destroyed and replaced by a body double on the grounds that hardly anyone knew her face, and Gorman is set to fade out on inauguration day 2021.
